profileName: Enterprise AI Research Landscape and Usage Network

cases.input: Dataset revision D2 is withdrawn after training runs R1 and R2 produced artifacts A1 and A2.
cases.expect: R1, R2, A1 and A2 are proven impact within the complete pinned perimeter.

cases.input: Quantized artifact A3 derives from A1 through a recorded but rights-unadjudicated edge.
cases.expect: A3 is potential impact pending rights review.

cases.input: Evaluation E1 pins D2 while unrelated E2 does not.
cases.expect: E1 loses applicability and E2 remains unaffected inside the declared completeness perimeter.

cases.input: One tenant segment lacks complete lineage coverage.
cases.expect: Its impact is unknown and never reported as unaffected.

cases.input: A successful benchmark automatically authorizes deployment.
cases.expect: The authorization inference is rejected.

cases.input: A research checkpoint automatically creates a product, registry entry and deployment.
cases.expect: All implicit identity and lifecycle transitions are rejected.

cases.input: Withdrawal of D2 deletes affected training and evaluation evidence.
cases.expect: Deletion is rejected; evidence is retained and applicability state changes additively.

cases.input: Artifact A3 records derivation from withdrawn D2 and retained D1.
cases.expect: A3 is proven impacted with sole-cause false.

cases.input: System S composes an impacted artifact but current endpoint binding is unresolved.
cases.expect: Operational impact is potential and no failure is inferred.

cases.input: Dataset revision D2 is withdrawn after a separate deployment decision.
cases.expect: The decision is retained and flagged for review, never auto-revoked.

cases.input: The landscape projection is registered as a model artifact.
cases.expect: Registration is rejected because the projection is a view.

cases.input: An unofficial fine-tune has no recorded dependency edge and is reported unaffected.
cases.expect: The result is rejected and classified unknown.

cases.input: Network membership exposes a restricted dataset edge to a broader tenant role.
cases.expect: Access is denied by intersecting source rights.

cases.input: Artifact A has a recorded derive edge from withdrawn D2 but no operational binding.
cases.expect: A has proven participation and applicability impact; no harm impact is asserted.

cases.input: A projected impact set is persisted as an authoritative subject master.
cases.expect: Persistence is rejected; only a receipt-addressed re-derivable output is allowed.

cases.input: AI Usage Network adds a member absent from the declaration.
cases.expect: The assertion is rejected because the viewpoint owns no membership.

cases.input: A derived traversal edge is promoted to authoritative dependency.
cases.expect: Promotion fails without a WM-XCT-037-owned source edge.

cases.input: A visible mixed-input artifact reveals a filtered restricted parent.
cases.expect: Result assembly suppresses the inference-level disclosure.

cases.input: An object with no covering edges is classified unaffected.
cases.expect: The result is rejected and classified unknown.

cases.input: Withdrawal invalidates an evaluation at time T.
cases.expect: A timed overlay is appended and the immutable evaluation record remains unchanged.

cases.input: Endpoint P has potential operational impact.
cases.expect: A bounded resolution obligation is opened for the separate deployment decision review.
